program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Tile the input with its clockwise, half-turn, and counter-clockwise rotations.
    top_right = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    bottom_left = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    bottom_right = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]

'''
